newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber stable at noon as eyes on INRO.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber stable at noon as eyes on INRO.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were generally stable in noon trading on Thursday with traders expecting the International Natural Rubber Organisation (INRO) to enter the market soon.
They said deals were done overnight at 43.50 U.S. cents/lb for September shipment fob Medan and at 43.20 fob Palembang. Offer prices were quoted at 43.00 fob Padang, Surabaya, Pontianak and Jambi.
"Market sentiment is still bearish but traders are expecting INRO to enter the market in order to prop up prices," said one trader in Padang, West Sumatra.
The trader said he had news that INRO had started to circulate terms and conditions forms to dealers in the U.S., indicating the organisation might enter the market soon.
"I heard that INRO has started to circulate the form to the U.S. dealers, regarding prices, port, quality and so on," he said.
Traders in Kuala Lumpur have said they might see the INRO five-day average moving nearer to the "may buy" level which meant that the organisation might intervene to prop up the market.
The five-day moving average was 185.11 Malaysian/Singapore cents a kg on July 8 against 187.60 on July 7. The daily indicator price was 181.84 against 182.89.
